prompt:
Bowling-club (Kegelclub) tour T-shirt print, portrait, isolated on a plain empty background.

Content that must appear:
- the club name, reading exactly "{club}", as the biggest lettering
[[- a line reading exactly "{ziel}" in big block letters]]
[[- a small round badge reading exactly "{jahr}"]]
[[- a curved script line reading exactly "{spruch}"]]

This is German nine-pin KEGELN, never ten-pin bowling. The equipment has to be right:
- a full set is always NINE pins in a SQUARE STANDING ON ITS POINT (a diamond), in rows of one, two, THREE, two, one. The middle pin is the KOENIG: a little taller than the other eight, with a small cap on top. Never a triangle, never ten pins.
- otherwise pins are a graphic element, not the set: show one, two or three of them, clearly apart. The only permitted numbers are ONE, TWO, THREE or exactly NINE - count them before you finish.
- the pins are slim and plain, light wood or white, with at most one narrow coloured ring; never the fat bowling pin with two red neck stripes.
- the ball is a KEGELKUGEL: small and smooth, roughly the size of a grapefruit, and it has NO HOLES AT ALL. Never the big bowling ball with three drilled finger holes.
- the lane is narrow and dark, an asphalt track with a raised channel on each side - never the wide pale oiled bowling lane.

The central motif and the arrangement follow the variation given below - a different picture every time.

Style: retro American diner sign made for dark fabric: cream and cherry red as main colors, dark teal only as outline and shadow color, all lettering light, halftone shading, worn print texture, no gradients, no photorealism.
